scripts.dev: yarn workspace @ems/contracts run build && yarn workspace @ems/backend run build && concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "yarn workspace @ems/contracts run dev" "yarn workspace @ems/backend run dev" "yarn workspace @ems/frontend run dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @ems/contracts run build && yarn workspace @ems/backend run build && yarn workspace @ems/frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @ems/contracts run build && yarn workspaces foreach --all --topological run typecheck
scripts.test: yarn workspace @ems/contracts run build && yarn workspaces foreach --all run test
